landing.headline: Know if your medicine is still safe — from a single pack photo.
landing.support: Upload a label. We read manufacturing and expiry dates, then tell you whether the pack is still valid.
landing.sectionTitle: From pack photo to clear answer
landing.sectionBody: Snap or upload a medicine pack image. MedExpiry extracts manufacturing and expiry dates, checks whether expiry is still in the future, and speaks the result in your language — so anyone in the household can understand the status.

detect.title: Check a medicine pack
detect.subtitle: Upload a clear photo of the manufacturing and expiry area. Analysis can take a minute or two while the vision models run.
detect.loadingHint: Reading manufacturing and expiry dates from your image. Please keep this tab open — this can take several minutes.
